question: Is it true that more SMEs pay in Czech koruna than in euros? If so, how many more?
actual_sql:
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_czk_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sme_eur_count,
  SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'CZK' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - SUM(CASE WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS difference
FROM customers
WHERE segment = 'SME';
expected_response: {"evidence": "Amount of more SMEs = Total of SMEs pay using Currency CZK - Total of SMEs pay using Currency EUR"}
